moworks.notes: q = easeInOutCubic over 700 ms: a shape from scene A (circle r 46, left) morphs point by point into scene B's shape (square r 46, right) with equal point counts (64), travelling across; a full-frame colour veil peaks mid-way (opacity sin(pi q)) and the scenes swap behind it at q = 0.5. Params: shapeA / shapeB · duration (0.7 s) · ease (power2.inOut).
